description: Pytest configuration and fixtures for FastAPI BackendAPIService tests, including environment setup, database initialization, test client creation, and authentication token retrieval.

methods.name: _set_env_for_tests
methods.description: Sets environment variables for predictable test environment, including JWT secret and database URL.

methods.name: test_engine
methods.description: Creates and returns a dedicated SQLite engine for testing.

methods.name: TestingSessionLocal
methods.description: Provides a session factory bound to the test engine.

methods.name: setup_database
methods.description: Creates all database tables and seeds initial test data, including users and reports.

methods.name: app_with_overrides
methods.description: Provides a FastAPI app instance with database dependency overridden for testing.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Creates an unauthenticated TestClient for testing API endpoints.

methods.name: admin_token
methods.description: Retrieves JWT token for admin user for authenticated requests.

methods.name: user_token
methods.description: Retrieves JWT token for normal user for authenticated requests.

methods.name: admin_client
methods.description: Provides an authenticated TestClient as admin.

methods.name: user_client
methods.description: Provides an authenticated TestClient as normal user.
